We are hiring a Finance Analyst for our Mumbai office. You will own month-end close, prepare management reports, and reconcile accounts. Requirements: 2+ years in finance or accounting, strong Excel and SQL, experience with Power BI dashboards, audit support, and reconciliation. Knowledge of Tally or SAP is a plus. You will work with stakeholders across business units, improve reporting accuracy, and communicate findings clearly. Familiarity with financial modelling and variance analysis preferred. Join a collaborative team that values accuracy, ownership and learning, and help us build faster and more reliable reporting for leadership every month of the year.
